points.text: The probabilities in a discrete distribution sum to 1, so P(X = 2) = 1 - 0.2 - 0.5 = 0.3.
Every discrete probability distribution sums to exactly 1 because something has to happen

items.prompt: A probability table for X lists P(X = 0) = 0.2 and P(X = 1) = 0.5, with X = 2 the only other outcome. Find P(X = 2) and state the rule you used.

points.text: Choose which 3 of the 10 trials succeed - 120 ways - then multiply by the probability of one such path: 3 successes at 0.3 each and 7 failures at 0.7 each

items.prompt: Let X be the number of successes in 10 independent trials, each with success probability 0.3. Write down the formula for P(X = 3) and evaluate it.

points.text: Sets dy/dx = 0 and solves to x = 1 and x = 3

items.prompt: A curve has equation y = x^3 - 6x^2 + 9x. Find dy/dx and the x-coordinates of its stationary points.

points.text: Writes A = pi r^2 and applies the chain rule dA/dt = 2 pi r dr/dt
Substitutes r = 4 and dr/dt = 0.5 to give 4 pi cm^2/s

items.prompt: The radius of a circle increases at 0.5 cm/s. Find the rate at which its area increases when the radius is 4 cm.

levels.descriptor: Methods are chosen and applied exactly, sum checks and formulas are stated, and conclusions are justified.
levels.label: Secure

levels.descriptor: Method is correct in outline but a sum check, coefficient or standard-deviation step is skipped.
levels.label: Developing

levels.descriptor: Methods are misapplied - for example pricing tails above 1/2 after a run of heads - and the working does not support the answer.
levels.label: Beginning
